data.gender_notes: Kommu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Kommu is derived from the word 'Kam' meaning desire and 'Kar' meaning do. The name Kommu represents the command or will of Goddess Durga. It symbolizes strength, courage, and determination to fulfill one's desires. The name Kommu carries the meaning “Goddess Durga's command” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kommu usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess durga's command and live with faith, good character and purpose.
